observations: The Adafruit 150 mAh LiPo (left) and nice!nano BLE controller (right) are rendered as small, distant solids inside a faint wireframe/ghosted outline of the Corne enclosure base, with dashed conceptual relationship arcs between them.

The Corne PCB, underside hot-swap sockets, switch plate, MX switches, and retained USB-C receptacle are ghosted or hidden in this isolated view, so vertical and lateral obstructions are not visually apparent.

The rendered battery box omits the 100–127.5 mm wire leads and JST-PH-2P plug shown on page 5 of the PKCELL datasheet (which also notes 'Reverse the plug JST PH-2P' and a 4.0+/-0.3mm thickness tolerance alongside Adafruit's stated 3.8 mm thickness), and pixel rendering cannot verify numeric clearance, wiring, or electrical operation.
